entities.name: NonceUE
entities.description: An information element included by the UE during specific inter-system change scenarios when TIN is set to P-TMSI.

entities.name: A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode inter-system change in idle mode
entities.description: Condition where UE performs inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode while in idle mode.

entities.name: TIN set to P-TMSI
entities.description: Condition where Temporary Identity used in Next update (TIN) parameter is set to P-TMSI value.

relations.description: NonceUE inclusion is guarded by the condition of inter-system change from A/Gb or Iu mode to S1 mode in idle mode.
NonceUE inclusion is guarded by the condition that TIN is set to P-TMSI.
